text:
Deeply saddened by the tragic loss of lives and widespread devastation caused by the earthquake in Indonesia.

On behalf of the people and Government of Pakistan, I extend my heartfelt condolences to President Prabowo Subianto, the people of Indonesia and the bereaved families.
translated_text:
对印度尼西亚地震造成的悲惨生命损失和广泛破坏深感悲痛。

我代表巴基斯坦人民和政府，向普拉博沃·苏比安托总统、印度尼西亚人民和遇难者家属表示衷心哀悼。

text: Pakistan has many ideas, but it has not been able to put them into practice. Political stability is needed for economic development. The system needs uniformity, not unity, Benazir Shah@Benazir_Shah
translated_text: 巴基斯坦有很多想法，但一直没能付诸实践。经济发展需要政治稳定。系统需要统一，而不是统一，Benazir Shah@Benazir_Shah

text: America wants to restore the Strait of Hormuz to its pre-war status. Trump's statement on seizing the Strait of Hormuz is merely a threat. Conditions aboard the aircraft carrier Abraham Lincoln are also deteriorating. Such statements are obstacles in the path of negotiations,
translated_text: 美国希望将霍尔木兹海峡恢复到战前状态。特朗普关于夺取霍尔木兹海峡的言论只是一种威胁。亚伯拉罕·林肯号航空母舰上的情况也在恶化。这些言论是谈判道路上的障碍，

text: Pakistan faces capacity issues for economic progress. In the past, whenever the opportunity arose, Pakistan worked to a certain extent, but it could not establish a structure through which Pakistan could become self-reliant, Umar Cheema@UmarCheema1
translated_text: 巴基斯坦面临经济进步的能力问题。过去，只要有机会，巴基斯坦就会在一定程度上做出努力，但无法建立一个让巴基斯坦能够自力更生的结构，Umar Cheema@UmarCheema1

text: Trump has spoken about seizing the Strait of Hormuz at a political rally. This makes it clear that the war has become a tool for domestic political use for both countries, Umar Cheema@UmarCheema1
translated_text: 特朗普在一次政治集会上谈到了夺取霍尔木兹海峡的问题。这清楚地表明，战争已成为两国国内政治利用的工具，Umar Cheema@UmarCheema1

text: Trump keeps giving expansionist statements. Iran will never take the Strait of Hormuz in an insignificant manner. Such statements will harm negotiations in the future, and American control over the Strait of Hormuz is practically not possible either, Fakhar Durani@FrehmanD
translated_text: 特朗普不断发表扩张主义言论。伊朗绝不会以无足轻重的方式占领霍尔木兹海峡。此类声明将损害未来的谈判，美国控制霍尔木兹海峡实际上也是不可能的，Fakhar Durani@FrehmanD

text: Pakistan faces challenges in security, relations with neighbors, and converting debts into investments. So far, it has not achieved satisfactory success in this regard. Continuity of policies is a major need for investment, Fakhre Alam Afridi@FrehmanD
translated_text: 巴基斯坦在安全、与邻国的关系以及将债务转化为投资方面面临挑战。到目前为止，它在这方面还没有取得令人满意的成功。政策的连续性是投资的主要需求，Fakhre Alam Afridi@FrehmanD
